name: Bouin Kouya - Hakudaku no Bitch Hime ~Anata no Ookii no Dondon Watashi ni Buchikonde♥~/Guerrilla Shoujo Hunt ~Tsukamattara Mohican Yarou no Seieki Benjo~
original_name: 暴淫荒野 白濁のビッチ姫 ～あなたの大きいのドンドン私にぶち込んで♥～／ゲリラ少女ハント ～捕まったらモヒカン野郎の精液便所～
source:
・Clouded Bitch Princess ～Pound Your Big One into Me Relentlessly～
In a devastated world lies a haven, once a grand shopping mall boasting of its prosperity. A girl appears in this relatively safe zone, seeking help and shelter from the outlaws roaming the wastelands. However, her arrival also marks the beginning of the paradise's downfall. Men, who had been collaborating for survival, slowly began to turn against each other, influenced by the presence of this single girl.

・Guerrilla Virgin Hunt ～If Caught, Become the Sperm Toilet of Mohawked Brutes～
The ordinary peaceful days ended abruptly, transitioning to a world dominated by ○○. Though constantly exposed to danger, a pair of sisters, refusing to align with the helpless and apathetic masses, wander in search of safety while fending off attacks from the rampant men scattered everywhere. The destination they head towards is either hope or despair.
translation:
【阴郁婊子公主～把你的大家伙不停塞进我体内～】灾后世界中有一处避难所，原本是宏伟购物中心。一个女孩来到相对安全的区域，向庇护所求助，躲避荒原上的亡命之徒。然而，她的到来也标志着天堂开始崩塌。原本为了生存合作的男人们，在这个女孩出现后逐渐彼此反目。

【游击少女猎捕～被抓住就会成为莫希干暴徒的精液马桶～】平凡和平的日子突然结束，世界被○○支配。一对姐妹不断面临危险，却拒绝加入无助冷漠的人群，在四处散落、不断袭击的男人之间寻找安全。她们最终前往的地方，是希望还是绝望？
